title: The Ahadi after Black Tooth
summary: How the African Fera came to unite.

claims.text: After Black Tooth’s purge, Simba prides came close to wiping out a whole Tanzanian group of Ajaba, and the other Fera kept silent until a young Ajaba persuaded them to unite as the Ahadi.
Ajaba once held that their purpose was to kill the weak so the strong could thrive; since the massacre many have come to believe that strength lies in shared purpose.
